name: Hotel Krone
beschreibung: Hotel Krone in Oberperfuss is located approximately 15 kilometres west of Innsbruck. Its setting provides swift access to the Rangger Köpfl ski area and surrounding hiking trails in the Stubai Alps. Guest rooms are comfortably furnished, many with balconies offering mountain views. The on-site restaurant serves traditional Tyrolean cuisine. Facilities include a wellness area with sauna, free Wi-Fi, and private parking.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Krone in Oberperfuss offers cozy alpine lodging, a sauna wellness area, Tyrolean dining, and direct access to the Rangger Köpfl ski area.
